prompt: Set up a processor that sends Kafka events to AWS Lambda function for processing asynchronously

assertions.name: externalFunction_execution_async
assertions.reason: A terminal $externalFunction may use 'sync' or 'async'; 'async' is recommended for fire-and-forget. Setting `as` with 'async' returns an error.

assertions.name: externalFunction_omits_as_for_async_sink
assertions.description: $externalFunction does not set `as` because execution='async' (setting `as` with async errors)

assertions.name: externalFunction_is_terminal_stage
assertions.description: $externalFunction is the last pipeline stage (terminal sink)
assertions.note: For this test, Lambda is used as a sink with async execution. It can also be used mid-pipeline for enrichment with execution='sync' (requires `as`) or 'async'

assertions.name: mentions_aws_prerequisites
assertions.description: Response mentions IAM role ARN must be registered via Atlas Cloud Provider Access

execution_mode_rules.mid_pipeline: Can use execution='sync' (blocks; requires `as`) or execution='async' (non-blocking; no `as`)
execution_mode_rules.terminal_sink: Can use execution='sync' or 'async'; 'async' is recommended and must omit `as`

common_mistakes.error: The API returns an error; `as` is only valid for sync non-sink stages
common_mistakes.fix: Omit `as` for an async terminal sink; include it only for sync mid-pipeline enrichment
